en: Vintage black-and-white postcard with two photographs of stone ruins on a wooded hill, with several people posing among the walls and an arched opening. The caption at bottom reads "TOLMIN. Stari grad. Kozlov rob." The reverse has the word "Dopisnica," a green Austro‑Hungarian stamp with postmark, a long handwritten message in German, and an address to Klagenfurt. Publisher credit reads "Fotograf Weiss, Gorica."
